name: synthetic-library-v3-terse
description: A terse slice of synthetic-library-v3: 163 queries, one per answerable English v3 query, each asking the same thing and keeping that query's relevance judgements and answer spans. Lengths follow the short half (at or below the median) of the measured Lattice user messages in length_reference, by quantile mapping from the v3 lengths; wording keeps only the names and identifiers a person would type and avoids the answering document's other words. Built and checked by scripts/terse_slice.py; see evals/retrieval/README.md.

length_reference.source: user messages in Josh's Lattice database (app data dir tech.lattice.app/lattice.db) and its 2026-09-19 backup, opened read-only; distinct messages by content digest; word count = whitespace-separated tokens. Only counts were read.
